module "P_PragmaKeys.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_PragmaKeys"
  pipeline order=-3 injection=PostProcess.AfterDOF views=Game|SceneCapture requires=PostProcess|CustomStencil enabled=On
  parameter "On" bool default=true
  parameter "Strong" bool default=false group="Switches" sort=4
  buffer "Tone" RGBA16F resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1 export
  pass "Grade" copy injection=PostProcess.AfterDOF enabled=Strong
    read SceneColor = SceneColor
    write Tone = Tone
